think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s normal domain and meaning. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/exception values (e.g., -1, 0) that change the knob’s behavior qualitatively (disable/enable a different mode) rather than just adjusting magnitude. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
